ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Autopilot can fly most of a route, but a person in the cockpit still decides whether sudden weather requires a diversion and whether a system alert calls for manual control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 100,000 Airline and Commercial Pilots employed in 2024, rising to a projected 103,900 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 3,900 jobs and about 11,700 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $226,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pilots. Licensed pilots must handle critical takeoff and landing phases, judge abnormal situations, and carry final safety responsibility. Neither law nor the public will accept a passenger aircraft without a captain. AI can monitor cruise and optimize routes, but machines cannot accept responsibility for everyone on board.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted route optimization and weather forecasting
Electronic flight bags replace paper materials
Real-time data links improve situational awareness
AI supports abnormal-situation and simulator training
ai_s2_auto: Software-based flight planning and fuel calculations
Digital flight records and dispatch documents
ai_s3_list: Takeoff and landing feel: real-time corrections in wind shear.
Abnormal-situation decisions: make fast judgments with incomplete information.
Crew coordination: the art of cockpit resource management.
Accountability: never compromise the safety baseline.
Experienced intuition: sensitivity to unusual sounds and attitudes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score identifies pilots as a high-responsibility career with relatively low AI exposure. Automation already handles much routine flight, but takeoff and landing, abnormal-situation response, and public accountability require people in the cockpit. AI cannot replace licensed pilots in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not eliminate risk. As automation advances, pilots shift from aircraft operators toward system managers and decision-makers. The future needs pilots who understand automation and collaborate effectively with human-machine systems.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Aspiring pilots should prioritize civil aviation recruitment and airline-sponsored training. Physical fitness is a firm threshold. Prepare for the cost and timeline: even sponsored training takes four or five years. Families should be realistic because not every student fits the pressure of flying.

Master English and aircraft-type qualifications, and watch opportunities in general aviation, cargo, and new-aircraft conversions. Learn automation principles and follow the shift toward human-machine collaboration. Protect your health because it is the foundation of a flying career.

Adults changing careers generally must fund their own flight training, which is expensive and lengthy, so calculate the return carefully. People with technical backgrounds, strong English, and qualifying health can earn licenses and hours before pursuing general aviation or cargo opportunities.

Pilot training is extremely expensive. Retain pilots through clear advancement paths, stable schedules, and quality-of-life support. Evaluate judgment, resilience, and crew coordination rather than only flight hours, because those capabilities protect safety.

ai_s7_trends: As automation and AI support systems spread, pilots are becoming system managers.
General aviation, cargo, and unmanned aircraft operations create new career paths.
Crew coordination and human factors training receive greater emphasis.

body: Airline and Commercial Pilots fly aircraft on passenger, cargo, and general aviation missions. They conduct preflight inspections and planning, control takeoff, cruise, and landing, navigate and communicate, and respond to abnormal situations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动驾驶能让飞机自己飞大半程，但「天气突变要不要绕飞、这个系统报警要不要人工接管」——最终拍板的，还是驾驶舱里的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年航空公司与商业飞行员职业诊断在岗约 10.00 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.39 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 22.66 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代飞行员：起降的关键阶段、特情处置的判断和最终安全责任都必须由持证飞行员承担，法律和公众都不会接受一架满载乘客的客机没有机长。AI 能接管巡航监控、优化航路，但「对一飞机人负责」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助航路优化与天气预测
电子飞行包替代纸质资料
实时数据链增强情境感知
AI 辅助特情培训与模拟训练
ai_s2_auto: 自动驾驶接管巡航阶段飞行
飞行计划与油量计算软件化
例行监控与告警自动化
飞行记录与签派文档电子化
ai_s3_list: 起降手感：风切变下的临场修正。
特情决断：信息不全时的快速判断。
机组协调：驾驶舱资源管理的艺术。
责任担当：安全底线绝不妥协。
经验直觉：异常声响与姿态的敏感。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明飞行员是「低 AI 曝光」的高责任职业：自动化已经接管大量常规飞行，但起降操纵、特情处置和公众责任都要求人必须在场，AI 短期内无法替代持证飞行员。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高枕无忧：自动化水平持续提升，飞行员正在从「操纵者」转向「系统管理者和决策者」。会理解自动化系统、能与人机系统协同的飞行员，才是未来需要的类型。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当飞行员，首选民航招飞渠道（航空公司委培），身体是硬门槛。要做好资金和周期准备：即使委培，培养周期也要四五年；家长要理性看待，不是所有孩子都适合飞行的压力。
把英语和机型资质吃透，关注通航、货运和新机型改装机会。学自动化系统原理，跟上「人机协同」的转型方向，同时管理好身体状态——这是飞行生涯的命根子。
成年后转行当飞行员基本走自费学飞，成本高、周期长，要算清投入产出。有理工背景、英语好、身体达标的人可以先考证攒小时，再找通航或货运公司机会。
飞行员培养成本极高，用「清晰的晋升通道 + 稳定的排班 + 生活质量保障」留人。别只看小时数，要考核判断力、抗压能力和机组协作，这些才是安全的关键。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化与 AI 支持系统普及，飞行员转向系统管理者。
通航、货运与无人机运行成为新的职业出口。
机组协同与人为因素训练更加受重视。

body: 航空公司与商业飞行员是航空与商业飞行员负责驾驶飞机执行航班任务，完成航前检查与飞行计划、操纵起飞巡航降落、进行空中导航与通信，并在异常情况下实施应急处置。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can scan slides and arrange karyotypes, but technologists still decide which translocation is present and which slide needs to be repeated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 351,200 technical specialists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 357,200 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 6,000 jobs, with about 22,600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $61,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cytogenetic Technologists, but it will assist scanning and initial screening. Automated karyotype scanning and abnormality alerts accelerate routine slide review, shifting technologists toward complex-abnormality interpretation, culture quality control, and result verification. Entry-level roles limited to routine scanning face pressure, while people who interpret findings and understand quality control become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Complex karyotypes: require people.
Culture control: requires experience.
Abnormality verification: requires trained eyes.
Result judgment: requires practice.
Emergency repeat testing: requires composure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure in laboratory work. AI assists slide scanning and initial screening, while culture and interpretation still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure brings change without eliminating the occupation. AI accelerates routine scanning and karyotype arrangement, not complex-abnormality interpretation and quality control. Technologists who interpret results and manage cultures become more resilient. Entry-level workers limited to routine scanning face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study medical laboratory science at the associate-degree level and gain hands-on experience with cultures and karyotypes. Routine scanning is shrinking in the AI era, so build interpretation skills early.
Move from scanning toward interpretation + quality control. Learn to use AI assistance and work toward supervisory roles.
Highlight the tests you can perform and whether you can interpret independently. Laboratories value stable, accurate work.
Look beyond certificates when hiring. Test candidates on complex-karyotype interpretation. Supervisors who can verify results deserve performance premiums.

ai_s7_trends: Automated scanning spreads, reducing routine slide review.
Prenatal and cancer genetics expand.
Technologists with interpretation and quality-control skills become more sought after.

body: Cytogenetic Technologists culture and prepare chromosome specimens, perform banding, scanning, and karyotype analysis, and identify numerical and structural abnormalities. Their laboratory findings support diagnosis of genetic disorders, developmental delays, and hematologic cancers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can scan slides and arrange karyotypes, but technologists still decide which translocation is present and which slide needs to be repeated.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动扫片排核型，但哪条易位、哪片该重做，还得技术员的眼和脑去定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术专家在岗约 35.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.72 万人，净增约 0.60 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代细胞遗传技术员，但会辅助扫描与初筛。自动核型扫描与异常提示把常规读片提速，技术员从「排核型」挪向「复杂异常判读、培养质控、结果复核」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规扫片的初级工，会判读懂质控的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 复杂核型：靠人。
培养把控：靠经验。
异常复核：靠眼。
结果判断：靠练。
应急重做：靠稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的实验区——扫片初筛被辅助，但培养与判读还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被加速的是「常规扫片与排核型」动作，不是「复杂异常判读与质控」的岗位。有判读力、能把控培养的技术员，反而更稳。怕的是只做常规扫片的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读医学检验大专，在校多摸培养与核型。AI 时代纯扫片在缩，早点练判读。
从「扫片」升级成「判读 + 质控」，学 AI 辅助，争取当主管。
突出会哪些项目、能不能独立判读。实验室看重稳和准。
选人别只看证书，要看会不会判读复杂核型。能把关的主管，值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 自动扫描普及，扫片缩。
产前与肿瘤遗传热。
会判读懂质控的更抢手。

body: 细胞遗传技术员培养制备染色体标本，进行显带、扫描与核型分析，识别数目与结构异常，为遗传病、发育迟缓与血液肿瘤的诊断提供实验室依据。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can classify and tag ten thousand documents within seconds, but people still decide which files must be retained, who can access them, and who is accountable when something goes wrong.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 472,000 management specialists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 510,500 by 2034. That represents about 38,500 additional jobs and roughly 31,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $109,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is replacing part of the work performed by Document Management Specialists. Automated classification, content extraction, metadata generation, and OCR are increasingly mature, shrinking execution-only roles fastest. AI cannot design workflows, govern access, set compliance strategy, or drive adoption across departments. The people who define the rules become more important.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent search that finds documents within seconds
AI detection of sensitive information for compliance review
Knowledge graphs that connect document assets across departments
Robotic process automation for archival workflows
ai_s2_auto: Automated document classification and tag generation
Content extraction and automatic metadata completion
Automatic execution of retention and deletion rules
ai_s3_list: Workflow and rule design: define classification, access, and retention policies.
Compliance judgment: decide what to retain and destroy under regulatory requirements.
Cross-department adoption: ensure that employees across the company use the system correctly.
Business understanding: know what each department actually needs to find.
AI quality control: recognize and correct automated classification errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places Document Management Specialists in the moderate-high AI exposure range. AI is taking over core execution tasks such as classification, metadata creation, and content extraction. Operations-only roles face the highest risk, while governance, compliance, and workflow design are increasingly valuable. The score reflects exposure at the execution layer, not the loss of professional value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not eliminate the career. Document Management Specialists who use AI and understand compliance governance can expand from managing documents to governing enterprise knowledge assets. Manual filing and organization roles face displacement first.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Information management and archival studies remain useful, but students should avoid a narrow focus on manual organization. Combine AI tools, data governance, and compliance knowledge, then pursue content governance and knowledge management instead of traditional archival administration alone.

Learn AI document tools and governance frameworks quickly, then move into compliance, knowledge management, and workflow design. A compliance or information-management certification can support the transition from organizing records to defining rules and governing systems.

Administrative, archival, and IT backgrounds all transfer well, with AI tools and data-governance knowledge forming the main entry barrier. A resume is stronger when it shows leadership of a document-system or framework rollout rather than a list of software names.

Assign execution-only document-control work to AI and systems, while hiring governance professionals who understand workflows, compliance, and organizational adoption. They can turn document assets into usable knowledge assets and justify higher compensation.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated storage, version control, and permissions
Automatic detection and alerts for sensitive content

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over classification and metadata generation, accelerating the decline of execution-only document roles.
Tighter data-compliance regulation raises the value of document governance and content security.
Document management expands into knowledge management, increasing demand for multidisciplinary governance professionals.

body: Document Management Specialists govern the full lifecycle of enterprise documents and knowledge assets. They design classification systems, search and access rules, electronic-record processes, content governance, and optimized workflows so documents remain compliant and searchable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can classify and tag ten thousand documents within seconds, but people still decide which files must be retained, who can access them, and who is accountable when something goes wrong.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在几秒钟内把一万份文档自动分好类、打好标签，但「哪些文件必须留、谁能看、出了问题谁负责」这些规矩，还是得人来定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年管理专员在岗约 47.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.05 万人，净增约 3.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在取代文档管理专家的一部分工作：自动分类、内容提取、元数据生成、OCR 识别都越来越成熟，纯执行型文档管理岗位收缩最快。但流程设计、权限治理、合规策略和跨部门推动，AI 做不了——「管规矩的人」反而更重要。
ai_s2_accel: 智能检索让员工秒级找到文档
AI 敏感信息识别支撑合规审查
知识图谱串联跨部门文档资产
RPA 机器人自动执行归档流转
ai_s2_auto: 文档自动分类与标签生成
内容提取与元数据自动补全
OCR 识别与档案数字化自动化
归档与清理规则的自动执行
ai_s3_list: 流程与规则设计：分类、权限、保留策略怎么定。
合规判断：监管要求下的文档保留与销毁决策。
跨部门推动：让全公司的人按规则用系统。
业务理解：知道各部门真正在找什么。
AI 结果把关：自动分类错了，得有人看出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这行是「中高曝光」职业——文档分类、元数据、内容提取这些核心执行环节正被 AI 大面积接管，纯操作岗风险最高；但治理、合规、流程设计等「定规矩」的环节反而更被需要，评分高的是执行层，不是价值层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于末路：会用 AI 工具、懂合规治理的文档管理专家，能把管理范围从「管文档」扩大到「管企业知识资产」，价值反而更大。真正被淘汰的是只会手工归档和整理的执行岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选信息管理、档案学专业可以，但要避开纯整理方向。让孩子把 AI 工具、数据治理、合规知识结合起来学，往「内容治理 + 知识管理」走，而不是当传统档案管理员。
尽快掌握 AI 文档工具和治理框架，往合规、知识管理和流程设计方向升级。考个合规或信息管理相关认证，从「执行整理」转向「定规则、管治理」。
有行政、档案、IT 背景的都适合转，门槛在 AI 工具和数据治理知识。简历上突出你主导过文档体系或系统上线项目，比罗列软件名更有说服力。
纯执行型文控岗可以交给 AI 和系统，重点招「懂流程、懂合规、会推动」的治理型人才；这类人能把文档资产变成可用的知识资产，值得给更高薪酬。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 敏感内容自动识别预警

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管分类与元数据生成，纯执行型文档管理岗位加速收缩。
数据合规监管趋严，文档治理与内容安全成为高价值方向。
文档管理向知识管理升级，复合型治理人才需求上升。

body: 文档管理专家负责企业文档与知识资产的全生命周期管理，包括分类体系设计、检索与权限规则、电子档案管理、内容治理与流程优化，确保文档合规、可检索。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在几秒钟内把一万份文档自动分好类、打好标签，但「哪些文件必须留、谁能看、出了问题谁负责」这些规矩，还是得人来定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Diagnostic tools can read trouble codes and AI can suggest checks, but hidden faults still require technicians to trace each wire. Examples include signal interference in one wire or a module that fails only under specific operating conditions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 10,300 Electronic Equipment Installers And Repairers, Motor Vehicles were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 8,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,400 jobs, with about 600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $47,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Electronic Equipment Installers And Repairers, Motor Vehicles, but it will change troubleshooting. Diagnostic tools are becoming smarter, AI fault analysis can suggest likely causes and test paths, and digital guidance covers standard installations. Vehicle-electronics faults often extend beyond one code. Aging harnesses, signal interference, module matching, and intermittent faults require technicians to combine circuit knowledge, data, and experience. Machines suggest; people decide.
ai_s2_accel: Smart diagnostic systems connected to cloud-based vehicle data
Remote expert support for difficult faults
Visual analysis of vehicle-network data streams
ai_s2_auto: Automatic reading and interpretation of trouble codes
AI fault analysis that generates troubleshooting recommendations
Digital installation procedures and wiring guidance
Electronic repair orders and parts information
ai_s3_list: Hidden-fault diagnosis: harness, interference, and connection problems beyond the data.
Circuit and bus-network judgment: understand network data streams and signal logic.
Installation details: experience and responsibility in routing, fastening, and protecting wiring.
Cross-system analysis: one fault can combine problems from several systems.
Customer communication: explain technical problems in language vehicle owners understand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate exposure. AI and smart diagnostic tools increasingly handle standard diagnosis, but the core of troubleshooting lies in hidden faults and cross-system analysis. These tasks depend on long experience and hands-on work. The occupation will shift from part replacement toward diagnostic expertise, favoring technicians who can read data and understand networks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean no change. Technicians who only replace parts from codes face displacement, while those who combine circuit diagrams, bus data, and experience become scarcer. Use smart diagnostics as a tool and build a strong foundation in system principles.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study automotive electronics, automotive repair, or electronic technology and practice circuit work and diagnostics in school. Prioritize bus networks, smart cockpits, and new-energy vehicle electronics, which are central to future vehicle repair.

Learn smart diagnostics, software flashing, and bus networks, then move toward new-energy and connected vehicles. Obtain a new-energy vehicle repair qualification and attend manufacturer training. Combined mechanical and electronic skills can command a premium.

People with electronics or electrical backgrounds can transition relatively smoothly. Start with an apprenticeship or training at a dealership or customization shop, then obtain an automotive electrical-repair certificate. In interviews, demonstrate circuit knowledge and a clear troubleshooting process, not certificates alone.

Do not treat technicians as parts replacers. Provide smart diagnostic equipment and training. Use skill-grade pay for electronics technicians and reward new-energy and connected-vehicle qualifications. Technical development retains talent more effectively than a base-pay increase alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically interpret trouble codes and data streams
Flash module software and calibrate parameters
Connect remotely with manufacturer technical experts
Search vehicle circuit diagrams and repair manuals
Electronic work orders, parts, and labor-time records

ai_s7_trends: Smart diagnostics and AI analysis are becoming common, greatly improving the efficiency of standard fault handling.
New-energy and connected vehicles continue to increase demand for electronic repair.
Technicians are developing combined diagnostic, software, and network skills.

body: Electronic Equipment Installers And Repairers, Motor Vehicles install, wire, commission, diagnose, and repair in-vehicle electronics such as audio systems, navigation, backup cameras, radar, and connected-vehicle modules. They keep vehicle electronic systems operating reliably.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Diagnostic tools can read trouble codes and AI can suggest checks, but hidden faults still require technicians to trace each wire. Examples include signal interference in one wire or a module that fails only under specific operating conditions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 诊断仪能读出故障码、AI 能给出排查建议，但「这根线的信号被干扰了、这个模块在某个工况才报错」——这类藏在数据背后的隐性故障，还得靠技师顺着线束一根根查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电子设备安装工、电机在岗约 1.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.89 万人，岗位净减约 0.14 万个，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.79 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代汽车电子维修工，但会改变排查方式：诊断仪越来越智能，AI 故障分析能直接给出排查路径和可能原因，标准化安装也有数字化指导。但车载电子的故障往往不是单一代码能说清的——线束老化、信号干扰、模块匹配、偶发故障，这些需要技师结合电路、数据和经验综合判断，机器给建议，人做决策。
ai_s2_accel: 智能诊断系统联动车型数据云
远程专家诊断辅助疑难故障
软件刷写与标定数字化
整车网络数据流可视化分析
ai_s2_auto: 诊断仪自动读取并解析故障码
AI 故障分析生成排查建议
安装流程与接线指导数字化
维修工单与配件信息电子化
ai_s3_list: 隐性故障排查：数据之外的线束、干扰、接触问题。
电路与总线判断：读懂网络数据流和信号逻辑。
安装细节：走线、固定、防护的经验与责任心。
多系统关联：一个故障可能是几个系统的叠加。
客户沟通：把技术问题讲成车主听得懂的话。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的「标准诊断」正被 AI 和智能诊断工具大幅接管，但故障排查的核心在于隐性问题和多系统关联判断——这些依赖长期经验和现场动手能力。岗位不会消失，而是从「换件工」向「诊断技师」升级，会读数据、懂网络的技师更吃香。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：只会按代码换件的维修工会被淘汰，而能结合电路图、总线数据和经验判断的技师反而更稀缺。把智能诊断当工具，把底层原理学扎实，才是应对之道。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 建议读汽车电子、汽车维修或电子技术专业，在校多练电路和诊断实操。把总线网络、智能座舱和新能源电子当重点，这些是未来修车的核心方向。
把智能诊断、软件刷写和总线网络学起来，往新能源和智能网联方向转型。考取新能源维修资质，参加厂商培训，从「机修+电子」复合技能里找溢价。
有电子、电工背景的转行相对顺：先学徒或培训，从 4S 店和改装店入门，再考汽车维修电工证。面试展示你的电路功底和排查思路，比证书更打动人。
别把技师当换件工用，配置智能诊断设备并送培训。给电子技师设置技能等级薪酬，鼓励新能源与网联资质，技术留人才比加底薪更有效。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动解析故障码与数据流
模块程序刷写与参数标定
远程连线厂商技术专家
车型电路图与维修手册检索
工单、配件与工时电子化

ai_s7_trends: 智能诊断与 AI 分析普及，标准故障处理效率大幅提升。
新能源与智能网联汽车推动电子维修需求持续增长。
技师向「诊断 + 软件 + 网络」复合技能转型。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can create schedules and documents, but Morticians, Undertakers, And Funeral Arrangers still decide when a farewell needs more time, how to guide the family, and how to steady the service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 27,500 Morticians, Undertakers, And Funeral Arrangers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 28,400 by 2034, a net gain of about 900 jobs, with roughly 3,200 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $49,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Morticians, Undertakers, And Funeral Arrangers. Systems can accelerate procedures and paperwork, but they cannot replicate support through grief, family coordination, on-site control, or dignity at a major life transition. Scheduling and clerical back-office tasks face only limited impact.
ai_s3_list: Emotional presence: people respond to grief.
Family coordination: people negotiate tradeoffs.
On-site control: people steady the pace.
Dignity at life's end: people uphold ceremony.
Complex cases: people exercise sensitive judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the low AI exposure range. Systems affect only back-office processes, while companionship and on-site work remain fully human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure also means limited risk. AI replaces back-office actions, not direct work with families. Workers who only schedule services face pressure, but the occupation itself remains deeply human.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build psychological resilience and communication skills, and earn required credentials early. In the AI era, this occupation places even greater value on human ability.
Move from processing procedures to supporting families and steadying the service. Learn regulations and coordination.
Emphasize the types of families and on-site situations you have handled, and clearly list your credentials.
Hire for composure and empathy. Core staff who can steady the service are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Online appointments are becoming common and standardizing reception work.
Companionship and on-site services still depend on people.
Funeral arrangers with strong coordination skills are more resilient.

body: Morticians, Undertakers, And Funeral Arrangers coordinate funeral arrangements. They discuss family needs, prepare documents, arrange cremation or burial, and lead farewell services on site.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can create schedules and documents, but Morticians, Undertakers, And Funeral Arrangers still decide when a farewell needs more time, how to guide the family, and how to steady the service.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能排期出文书，但哪场告别要慢一点、怎么陪家属走完、现场怎么稳，还是承办人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年殡仪承办人与丧葬安排员在岗约 2.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.84 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.98 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代殡仪承办人。流程与文书可被系统提速，但面对 grief 的陪伴、家属协调、现场把控与生命节点的庄重感，几乎无法被机器替代。被轻微影响的是排期与文书这类后台动作。
ai_s3_list: 情绪陪伴：grief 靠人接。
家属协调：取舍靠人谈。
现场把控：节奏靠人稳。
生命庄重：仪式靠人守。
复杂个案：敏感靠人判。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——系统只碰后台流程，核心的陪伴与现场仍完全靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：这里 AI 只替后台动作，不碰面对家属的核心。怕的是只会排期的人，但这类岗位本就重人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 心理与沟通要练，资质要早拿，AI 时代这行更看人。
从「办流程」升级成「陪家庭 + 稳现场」，学法规与统筹。
突出跟过的家庭类型与现场经验，写清资质。
选人看沉稳与共情，能稳现场的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 线上预约普及，前台标准化。
陪伴与现场仍靠人。
有统筹力的承办人更稳。

body: 殡仪承办人与丧葬安排员协调丧葬安排，与家属沟通需求、准备文书、安排火化或安葬，并现场主持告别流程。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能排期出文书，但哪场告别要慢一点、怎么陪家属走完、现场怎么稳，还是承办人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can handle monitoring, but operators still inspect unusual sounds and decide how to respond to emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 5,400 Gas Compressor And Gas Pumping Station Operators jobs in 2024, projected to fall to 5,300 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 100 jobs, with roughly 600 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $71,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace compressor-station operators, but it will reduce entry-level control-room monitoring. SCADA automates monitoring records, shifting operators from watching gauges toward inspections, emergency response, and equipment judgment. Data-copying roles face pressure, while people who inspect equipment and handle incidents become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site inspections: people recognize unusual sounds.
Emergency judgment: people decide the response.
Equipment awareness: people apply experience.
Safety controls: people verify each other.
Coordinated response: people direct operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate monitoring, while inspections and emergency response still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Systems replace data-copying and screen-monitoring tasks, not inspection and emergency-response roles. Operators who inspect and respond become scarcer as efficiency improves. Screen-only workers face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build equipment skills while starting in mechanical or electrical work. Pure control-room monitoring is shrinking, so develop inspection skills early.
Move beyond screen monitoring into inspection and emergency management. Learn predictive maintenance.
Highlight certifications and station experience. Specify the equipment you operated and maintained.
Do not hire on certifications alone. Evaluate composure and judgment. Experienced staff who inspect and respond effectively justify higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: SCADA adoption is reducing control-room monitoring work.
Predictive maintenance is becoming automated.
Experienced staff with inspection skills are increasingly sought after.

body: Gas Compressor And Gas Pumping Station Operators run and monitor compressors and pumping stations. They regulate pressure and flow, record operations, inspect hazards, and respond to anomalies to keep gas moving safely and reliably.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can handle monitoring, but operators still inspect unusual sounds and decide how to respond to emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测有系统接，但巡检异响和应急处置，还是操作员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年天然气天然气操作员在岗约 0.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.53 万人，岗位净减约 0.01 万个，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代加压站操作员，但会压缩初级监盘。SCADA 把监测记录自动化，操作员从「盯表」挪向「巡检、应急、设备判断」。真正被挤掉的是只抄数的，能巡检能处置的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场巡检：异响靠人。
应急判断：处置靠人。
设备感知：经验靠人。
安全把关：人盯人。
协调处置：调度靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——监测被系统加速，但巡检与应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「抄数盯盘」动作，不是「巡检应急」的岗位。能巡检、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电起步多练设备，AI 时代纯监盘在缩，早点练巡检。
从「盯屏」升级成「管巡检 + 应急」，学预测维护。
突出持证与站场经验，写清管过哪些设备。
选人别只看证，要看稳不稳。能巡检处置的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: SCADA 普及，监盘缩。
预测维护自动化。
能巡检的骨干更抢手。

body: 天然气压缩机与加压站操作员操作并监控压缩机与泵站，调节压力流量、记录运行、巡检隐患并处置异常，保障气体稳定安全输送。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can summarize a decade of research in five minutes, but teachers must guide students through what a source can and cannot prove.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 24,600 postsecondary history teachers employed in 2024, projected to remain about 24,600 by 2034. That is a net change of about 0 jobs, with roughly 1,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $81,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary history teachers, but it raises the baseline of research. Search, source organization, initial reviews, and slide generation are much faster, reducing low-quality information-transfer work. Teaching guidance, source criticism, and original research judgment gain value. Students need not the information AI supplies, but the teacher's sense of what questions matter.
ai_s2_accel: Digital-humanities tools assist quantitative source analysis
AI assists recognition and organization of ancient texts and archives
Faster production of research reviews and bibliographies
ai_s2_auto: Automated literature searches and information organization
Rapid generation of initial slides and outlines
Initial grading of assignments and examinations
ai_s3_list: Source criticism: teach students whether evidence supports a conclusion.
Classroom guidance: turn curiosity into researchable questions.
Original judgment: formulate real questions and offer new interpretations.
Thesis supervision: help students clarify arguments line by line.
Academic reputation: peer review depends on human relationships and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means history teaching and research are at a stage where AI is reconstructing source work. Tools replace difficult search, organization, and review tasks, freeing teachers from information transfer to focus on criticism, guidance, and original research.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure brings visible change. Scholars who cannot use digital-humanities tools fall behind in efficiency, while those using AI for source organization can devote saved time to original results. Tools are leverage, not opponents.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Studying history requires preparation for a doctorate and long-term up-or-out employment. Undergraduates should ask whether they truly enjoy reading sources and writing long papers. For many students, history is safer as an interest or minor beside a major with more direct employment.
Use digital-humanities tools and AI research assistants while expanding into public history, museums, and cultural consulting. Do not rely solely on faculty promotion as an exit.

History doctorates can transition to publishers, museums, cultural institutions, and think tanks. Build digital skills and project work, then emphasize transferable research, writing, and complex-explanation ability in interviews.

When recruiting history faculty, assess instructional design, digital-humanities skills, and effects on student research alongside publication count. Candidates using AI to improve preparation efficiency can reserve more time for students.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Cross-database search and initial review drafts
Quantitative analysis and visualization of historical sources
OCR organization of ancient texts and archives
Paper similarity checks and citation verification

ai_s7_trends: Digital humanities and AI become standard in historical research, greatly improving source-organization efficiency.
Competition for humanities faculty remains intense, while public-history and cultural-sector employment expands.
Teaching guidance and original research gain prominence, while information-transfer scholarship shrinks.

body: Postsecondary history teachers teach history in universities and colleges, guide students in source research and paper writing, conduct historical research, publish scholarship, and combine teaching, research, and public service.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能五分钟整理出十年的研究综述，但「这段史料能证明什么、不能证明什么」的辨析，得老师带着学生一段段读。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校历史教师在岗约 2.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.46 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校历史教师，但会改变「研究的下限」：文献检索、资料整理、综述初稿、课件生成都被大幅提速，低质量的信息搬运型工作被压缩。教学引导、史料辨析、原创研究判断这些核心职能反而更值钱——学生需要的不是 AI 能给的资料，是老师给的「问题意识」。
ai_s2_accel: 数字人文工具辅助史料量化分析
AI 辅助古籍与档案的识别整理
在线课程平台扩展教学触达
研究综述与书目生成的提速
ai_s2_auto: 文献检索与资料整理自动化
课件与大纲初稿快速生成
作业与试卷的初步批改
参考文献格式自动整理
ai_s3_list: 史料辨析：教学生判断一段材料能不能支撑结论。
课堂引导：把学生的好奇转成可研究的问题。
原创判断：提出真问题、给出新解释。
论文指导：逐字逐句帮学生把论证捋顺。
学术信誉：审稿、同行评价中的人情与判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明历史教学与研究正处于「资料端被 AI 重构」的阶段：检索、整理、综述这些苦活被工具取代，教师从「信息搬运」中解放出来，把精力放到辨析、引导和原创研究上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中位曝光不等于无感：不会用数字人文工具的学者，效率会明显落后；会用 AI 做史料整理的学者，可以把省下的时间用在真正产出原创成果上。工具是杠杆，不是对手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读历史学要做好「博士 + 非升即走」的长期准备，本科阶段先问自己是否真享受读史料和写长文。对多数孩子，建议把历史作为兴趣或辅修，主修更直接的就业方向更稳妥。
把数字人文工具和 AI 研究助手用起来，同时拓展公共史学、博物馆、文化咨询等出口，别把鸡蛋都放在教职晋升这一个篮子里。
历史学博士转型可去出版社、博物馆、文化机构、智库，先积累数字技能和项目作品；面试时突出「能研究、能写作、能讲清复杂问题」的通用能力。
招历史教师时，除了看论文数量，建议重点考察「教学设计 + 数字人文技能 + 对学生研究的影响」；用 AI 工具提升备课效率的候选人，通常能把更多时间留给学生。

「教学引导 + 原创研究」的价值凸显，信息搬运型学术工作被压缩。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Content tools can generate a picture-book lesson in seconds, but teachers still notice when a child is struggling and respond to the child's emotions with care.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace kindergarten teachers, but it will accelerate lesson preparation and communication. Content generation, family notices, and observation templates reduce administrative work, shifting teachers from writing plans toward observing children, providing emotional support, leading the class, and building family trust. Scripted teaching faces pressure, while knowledge of development and safety becomes more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of lesson plans and picture-book materials
ai_s3_list: Observe children: people recognize changes in behavior.

Lead the class: people handle unexpected events.
Family trust: people build relationships.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score indicates moderate AI exposure because systems accelerate materials and notices, while observation and emotional care remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation affects scripted teaching and documentation, not classroom guidance. Teachers who observe children and respond to emotions become more valuable, while those limited to reading lesson plans face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in early childhood education and practice observation and classroom-environment design while studying. Pure lesson preparation is shrinking in the AI era, so learn child development early.
Move from writing plans toward observing development and responding to emotions. Learn developmental screening and seek lead-teacher or teaching-research responsibilities.
Highlight classroom leadership and family-partnership examples, including the age groups you have supported. Preschools value reliability and genuine care.
Do not hire based only on singing and movement skills. Look for understanding of children; teachers who can lead a class and respond to emotions are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Content tools improve efficiency and reduce lesson-preparation time.
Quality improvements in inclusive preschool services sustain demand.
Teachers who observe children and respond to emotions become harder to find.

body: Kindergarten teachers, except special education, organize play and daily activities, observe and support children's language, social, and motor development, communicate with families, and teach safety. They guide preschool growth on the front line.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代幼儿园教师，但会加速备课与沟通。素材生成、家园通知和观察记录模板把事务提速，教师从「写教案」挪向「观察孩子、情绪陪护、现场带班、家园信任」。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科的人，懂发展和安全的老师更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 教案与绘本素材自动生成
ai_s3_list: 观察孩子：状态靠人看。
情绪陪护：接住靠人。
现场带班：突发靠人。
家园信任：关系靠人。
习惯培养：节奏靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的备课区——素材与通知被系统加速，但观察陪护还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「照本宣科与写材料」动作，不是「带班引导」的岗位。有观察力、能接情绪的老师，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会念教案的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学前教育打底，在校多练观察与环创。AI 时代纯备课在缩，早点懂发展。
从「写教案」升级成「做观察 + 接情绪」，学发展筛查，争取当主班或教研。
突出带班与家园案例，写清跟过哪些年龄段。园所看重稳和爱。
选人别只看会唱跳，要看懂不懂孩子。能带班接情绪的老师，值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 素材工具提效，备课缩。
普惠提质留需求。
懂观察接情绪的老师更缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An autonomous loader can follow a tunnel route precisely, but when a vehicle ahead is stuck or a rock bolt must be avoided in the ore, an operator still has to take over by remote control or from the cab.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 6,400 machine operators employed in 2024, projected to decline to 5,000 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 1,400 jobs, with roughly 500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $68,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not immediately replace underground loading and haulage operators, but underground mines are among the fastest environments for autonomous adoption. Tunnels are enclosed, routes fixed, and conditions controllable, and automated load-haul-dump machines (LHDs) are already in trials at mines in China, Europe, and the United States. Autonomy still requires control-room monitoring and exception handling, shifting operators from driving toward combined driving, remote control, and maintenance roles.
ai_s2_accel: Remote-control driving moves operators out of hazardous areas
AI vision recognizes tunnel obstacles and waste-rock contamination
Underground 5G networks support real-time vehicle positioning and coordination
Automated ore-pass draw systems reduce human intervention
ai_s2_auto: Autonomous LHDs travel automatically along fixed tunnel routes
Fleet-dispatch systems automatically assign tasks and routes
Equipment sensors automatically report faults and fuel levels
Automatic ore measurement and production reports
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: quickly take over when an autonomous vehicle is stuck, a tunnel floods, or equipment alarms.
Loading judgment: determine the correct bucket angle and force for different ore and rock.
Equipment maintenance: inspect fluids, filters, and wear under underground conditions.
Safety backstop: remain alert to abnormal ground support, ventilation, and gas concentrations.
Dispatch coordination: align the pace with blasting, hoisting, and electrical-mechanical crews.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score shows this occupation moving into faster autonomous adoption. Standardized loading and haulage are transitioning toward automation, while exception handling, equipment maintenance, and safety coverage still require substantial human labor. Roles will shift from operation toward combined operation, monitoring, and maintenance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk does not eliminate opportunity. People willing to learn remote operation, underground communications, and automated-equipment maintenance become highly sought after during mine transitions. Operators limited to memorized routes who avoid new systems will be the first displaced from the cab.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before entering mining, confirm that your physical condition and psychological resilience meet underground medical requirements. Study mining electrical-mechanical systems or mining engineering and treat automation, communications, and autonomous-equipment knowledge as core subjects.

Volunteer for autonomous-transformation projects and learn remote control, dispatch systems, and equipment maintenance. A hybrid path combining automated-equipment operation and maintenance is the strongest defense against autonomy.

Career changers must complete safety training and credentialing, starting in a surface support role or as a ride-along apprentice. Mines value stability and safety awareness, so highlight your safety record instead of focusing only on underground allowances.

During autonomous transformation, retrain experienced operators for remote monitoring and maintenance instead of treating them solely as replacement costs. Promotion paths for people who use automation systems can reduce turnover.

Operate underground equipment remotely from a control room
Automatically assign tasks, routes, and queues
Real-time vehicle positioning and data return
Recognize tunnel obstacles and waste-rock contamination
Real-time reporting of faults, fuel levels, and temperature
Automated ore drawing with less human intervention

ai_s7_trends: Underground autonomy moves from pilots toward deployment, automating standardized processes first.
Hybrid operators who combine operation, remote control, and maintenance become a core need during mine transformation.
Underground safety and communications technology improve, steadily improving the operating environment.

body: Loading and moving machine operators in underground mining operate LHDs, rock-loading machines, mine haul trucks, and related equipment in mine tunnels. They load, transfer, and haul ore underground and participate in equipment maintenance and safe operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人铲运车能在巷道里按线路跑得笔直，但「前面这台车卡了、矿岩里有根锚杆要绕开」这种局面，还得靠操作员把遥控器或驾驶位接管过来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器操作员在岗约 0.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.50 万人，岗位净减约 0.14 万个，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.89 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会立刻取代地下装载运输操作员，但井下正是无人化推进最快的场景之一：巷道封闭、路线固定、环境可控，自动化铲运机（LHD）已经在中国和欧美多个矿山试运行。现阶段无人化还需要人在控制室远程监控、处理异常，操作员正从「开车」转向「开车 + 遥控 + 维护」的组合角色。
ai_s2_accel: 远程遥控驾驶让操作员移出危险区域
AI 视觉识别巷道障碍与矿岩混入
井下 5G 网络支撑车辆实时定位与协同
自动化溜井放矿系统减少人工干预
ai_s2_auto: 无人铲运机沿巷道固定线路自动往返
车辆调度系统自动分配任务与路线
设备状态传感器自动上报故障与油量
矿石计量与产量报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 异常处置：无人车卡住、巷道积水、设备报警时快速接管。
铲装手感：不同矿岩的铲装角度与力度判断。
设备维护：井下环境的油液、滤芯、磨损检查经验。
安全兜底：顶板、通风、气体浓度异常的警觉。
调度协同：跟爆破、提升、机电班组把节奏对齐。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业正处在无人化渗透的上升通道：标准化铲装运输环节在向自动化过渡，但异常处理、设备维护和安全兜底仍需要大量人力。岗位不会一夜消失，而是从「操作」转向「操作 + 监控 + 维护」复合角色。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没出路：愿意学无人化设备遥控、井下通信和自动化维护的人，反而是矿山转型期最抢手的。相反，只会死记线路、不碰新系统的操作员，会先被无人化挤出驾驶室。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进矿山行业，先确认身体条件和心理承受力能过井下体检关。选矿山机电、采矿相关专业，把自动化、通信和无人化设备知识当核心课，未来是加分项。
主动申请参与无人化改造项目，把远程遥控、调度系统、设备维护学起来。往「自动化设备操作 + 维保」复合方向走，是应对无人化最好的护城河。
转行进矿山要过安全培训与取证关，从地面辅助岗位或跟车学徒起步。矿山看重稳定性和安全意识，别只盯着井下津贴，把安全记录当成自己的简历亮点。
无人化转型期，别把老操作员当成要被替代的成本，而是培训成远程监控和维保主力。给「会用自动化系统」的人设晋升通道，能降低流失率。

控制室远程操作井下设备
自动分配任务、路线与排队
车辆实时定位与数据回传
识别巷道障碍与矿岩混入
故障、油量、温度实时上报
减少人工干预的自动放矿
自动生成班次产量报表

「操作 + 遥控 + 维护」复合型操作员成为矿山转型期的核心需求。
井下安全与通信技术升级，操作环境持续改善。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Algorithms can automatically optimize routes and forecast demand, but analysts still decide which networks deserve service guarantees, how to negotiate with carriers, and how to recover from disruptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 241,000 logisticians were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 281,300 by 2034. That represents roughly 40,300 additional jobs and about 26,400 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $80,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace logisticians, but it will reduce manual work. Algorithms are taking over route optimization and demand forecasting, shifting analysts from routing to network design, carrier negotiation, exception handling, and strategic optimization. People who only route manually are being squeezed out; professionals with design skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Network design: people determine the architecture.
Carrier negotiation: people secure the rates.
Exception handling: people manage the emergencies.
Strategic optimization: people make the tradeoffs.
Cross-functional coordination: people build the trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: An 8/10 score means this occupation sits in a highly AI-exposed area of supply chains: algorithms absorb manual routing, while network design and negotiation still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. The activity being replaced is manual routing, not the network-design role. Professionals who can design systems and resolve exceptions become scarcer as productivity rises; those limited to mechanical routing face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in supply chain or logistics, build strong data skills. Pure routing work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop design capabilities early.
Advance from routing to network design and carrier management. Learn simulation and data analysis, then seek responsibility for larger networks.
Highlight network-management and cost-reduction results, and specify the product categories you handled. Employers value both operational stability and the ability to deliver under pressure.
Do not assess candidates solely on operational execution; look for network-design thinking. High performers who reduce costs deserve strong performance rewards.

ai_s7_trends: Algorithmic optimization becomes widespread, reducing manual work.
Network design creates opportunities.
Professionals who resolve exceptions become more sought after.

body: Logisticians plan and optimize the movement of goods from origin to customer. They coordinate transportation networks, inventory placement, carriers, and costs, using data to make delivery both timely and economical.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代物流分析师，但会压缩手工环节。路径优化与需求预测被算法接管，分析师从「排线」挪向「网络设计、承运商谈判、异常处置、战略优化」。真正被挤掉的是只做手工排线的人，有设计力的人更值钱。

承运商谈判：价位靠人。
异常处置：救火靠人。
战略优化：取舍靠人。
跨部门协调：信任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的供应链区——算法吃手工排线，但设计与谈判还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「手工排线」动作，不是「网络设计」的岗位。有设计力、能处置异常的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做机械排线的人。

网络设计带来机会。
能处置异常的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically monitor vital signs and send repositioning reminders, but people still provide the patience of close care, such as coaxing an older adult who has no appetite today to eat.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,441,500 assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,474,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 32,500 jobs, with approximately 204,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $39,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Nursing Assistants. Care combines physical contact with emotional commitment, and repositioning, feeding, bathing, and conversation all require hands-on human support. Robots can only handle peripheral tasks such as delivering medication and monitoring vital signs. AI can assist with scheduling, documentation, and data alerts, freeing assistants from paperwork and returning their time to patients.
ai_s2_accel: Smart repositioning mattresses and pressure-injury prevention equipment
Nursing robots that deliver medication and supplies
ai_s2_auto: Automated pressure-injury risk assessment and alerts
ai_s3_list: Repositioning technique: conserve effort and prevent injury.
Observational judgment: detect changes in mental status early.
Emotional companionship: encourage older adults to cooperate with care.
Communication and reassurance: respond to family anxiety.
Emergency response: handle falls and choking on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 makes Nursing Assistants a moderate-high exposure care occupation. Documentation, scheduling, and vital-sign data are being automated, but AI and robots cannot replace close personal care such as repositioning, feeding, and companionship in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not guarantee stability. Smart equipment is taking over simple care and documentation, reducing the value of assistants who only run errands. Move toward specialty nursing and eldercare management and make observation and communication core strengths. The larger the shortage, the more valuable you become.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students in nursing should not focus only on top-tier hospitals. Gaps are larger and policy support stronger in eldercare and community nursing. Master basic nursing procedures at school and earn a nursing credential to broaden your options.

Move toward specialties such as eldercare, rehabilitation nursing, and hospice care, and earn a caregiver skill-level certificate. Learn to use smart nursing equipment and devote time and energy to observation and companionship rather than errands and documentation.

People with domestic-service or early-childhood education backgrounds have advantages when changing to nursing. First earn a caregiver certificate and start at an eldercare organization, mastering repositioning, pressure-injury prevention, and first aid. In interviews, emphasize patience, stamina, and experience with older adults.

The key staffing problem in nursing is retention. Combine night-shift allowances, promotion paths, and psychological support, and use smart equipment to reduce workload so assistants' value lies in care rather than paperwork.

ai_s7_trends: Population aging is driving long-term growth in eldercare and community nursing demand.
Smart monitoring and nursing robots reduce documentation and repetitive work.
Nursing Assistants are advancing toward specialization, certification, and care management.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年助理在岗约 144.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 147.40 万人，净增约 3.25 万个岗位，年均产生约 20.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.95 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代护理助理：照护是身体接触加情感投入的工作，翻身、喂饭、擦身、陪聊都得手把手来，机器人只能做送药、体征监测这类外围。AI 能帮的是排班、记录和数据提醒，把护理员从文书里解放出来，把时间还给病人。
ai_s2_accel: 智能翻身床垫与防压疮设备
护理机器人送药与物资
ai_s2_auto: 生命体征自动监测记录
护理排班与交接数字化
压疮风险自动评估提醒

观察判断：精神状态异常早发现。
情感陪伴：让老人愿意配合照护。
沟通安抚：家属的焦虑接得住。
应急反应：跌倒、呛咳的现场处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明护理助理是「中高曝光」的照护岗位：记录、排班、体征数据正被自动化，但翻身、喂饭、陪护这些贴身照护，AI 和机器人短期替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于安稳：智能设备在分担简单照护和文书，纯「跑腿式」助理的价值在稀释。往专科护理、养老照护管理走，把观察和沟通练成核心竞争力，缺口越大你越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护理专业的孩子别只盯着三甲，养老护理和社区护理缺口更大、政策支持也多；在校把基础护理实操练熟，考下护士证，路就走宽了。
往养老照护、康复护理、安宁疗护等专科方向走，考护理员等级证；学会用智能护理设备，把时间和精力放在观察和陪护上，而不是跑腿和记录。
家政、幼教背景转护理有优势：先考护理员证从养老机构起步，把翻身、防压疮、急救学扎实；面试时强调耐心、体力和跟老人相处的经验。
护理岗缺人关键是留人难：建议「夜班补贴 + 晋升通道 + 心理支持」三管齐下，用智能设备减负，让护理员的价值体现在照护而不是文书上。

ai_s7_trends: 人口老龄化带动养老与社区护理需求长期增长。
智能监测与护理机器人减轻文书和重复劳动。
护理助理向专科化、持证化与照护管理方向升级。

body: 护理助理在注册护士指导下提供基础照护，负责生命体征监测、生活照料、翻身防压疮、病房清洁与患者安全，是医疗与养老服务链条中不可或缺的照护力量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动监测体征、提醒翻身，但「老人今天就是没胃口、得哄着吃」这种贴身照护的耐心，还得靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Rehabilitation robots can practice gait with patients, but you are still needed to notice that someone is not themselves today, is compensating during an exercise, or needs a different kind of encouragement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 111,500 physical therapist assistants were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 136,000, a net increase of about 24,500 jobs, with about 19,800 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $65,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and rehabilitation robots will not replace physical therapist assistants, but they will change how training is delivered. Exoskeletons and rehabilitation robots are assisting repetitive exercises, while AI assessment systems collect data. Assistants shift from simply leading practice toward guiding exercises, observing feedback, and adjusting plans. Machines cannot replace patient communication, movement demonstration, or real-time judgment during training.
ai_s2_accel: Remote rehabilitation guidance platforms become widespread
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of digital training records
Automatic parameter settings for therapeutic equipment
ai_s3_list: Patience in exercise guidance: correct a movement repeatedly without frustration.
Observation of patient condition: recognize subtle signs of pain, fatigue, and fear.
Judgment in real-time adjustment: adapt training intensity when a patient is having a difficult day.
The art of encouragement: help patients want to practice and continue practicing.
Safety awareness: prevent falls and strains before movement begins.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that records and assessments are becoming digital. AI and systems can assist with documentation, evaluation, and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI and robots take over repetitive training and data, leaving guidance, communication, and real-time judgment to people. Robots will assist or replace pure exercise-supervision roles, while assistants who understand assessment, communicate well, and adjust plans become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study rehabilitation therapy, exercise rehabilitation, or nursing, and complete a hospital internship. Build a strong anatomy foundation and practice patience when working with patients.

Learn to use rehabilitation robots, exoskeletons, and AI assessment systems and earn rehabilitation therapist credentials. Advance from leading practice to the combined role of assessment + guidance + plan adjustment.

A rehabilitation or nursing background offers the smoothest path. People without one can enter as rehabilitation assistants or physical therapy technicians and earn credentials while working. On your resume, specify the types of patients you have supported, equipment you can use, and certifications you have earned.
Do not assess assistants by credentials alone. Evaluate patience and observation. Young people willing to learn smart rehabilitation equipment deserve focused development.

ai_s7_trends: As rehabilitation robots and exoskeletons enter rehabilitation departments, assistants shift from pure exercise supervision to equipment operation + exercise guidance, increasing demand for assistants skilled with smart devices.
Population aging and rehabilitation-care expansion drive job growth, while rehabilitation therapist credentials become key to advancement.
As remote rehabilitation and wearable monitoring spread, assistants become hybrid professionals combining in-facility training + home follow-up.

body: Physical therapist assistants perform rehabilitation exercises and physical therapy procedures under physical therapists' direction. They guide patients through prescribed exercises, operate therapy equipment, and record responses and progress, serving as front-line practitioners on rehabilitation teams.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Rehabilitation robots can practice gait with patients, but you are still needed to notice that someone is not themselves today, is compensating during an exercise, or needs a different kind of encouragement.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 康复机器人能陪患者练步态，但「他今天状态不对、动作做变形了、需要换个方式鼓励」——这些观察和分寸，还得靠你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物理治疗师助理在岗约 11.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.60 万人，净增约 2.45 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.98 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.55 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和康复机器人不会取代物理治疗师助理，但会改变训练方式。外骨骼、康复机器人正在辅助重复训练环节，AI 评估系统帮忙采集数据，助理从「单纯带练」转向「指导训练、观察反馈、调整方案」。患者沟通、动作示范和训练中的临场判断，是机器替代不了的。
ai_s2_accel: 康复机器人辅助训练普及
外骨骼设备进入康复科
远程康复指导平台推广
ai_s2_auto: 训练记录电子化自动生成
AI 步态与关节活动度评估
理疗设备自动参数设定
ai_s3_list: 训练指导的耐心：动作做不对，一遍遍纠正不嫌烦。
患者状态的观察：疼、累、怕，细微反应看得出。
临场调整的分寸：今天状态不好，训练强度怎么调。
沟通鼓励的艺术：让患者愿意练、坚持练。
安全防护的意识：跌倒、拉伤，防在动作之前。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的记录与评估环节正在被数字化——记录、评估、排程，AI 和系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 和机器人接走的是「重复训练和数据」环节，留下的是「指导沟通和临场判断」环节。纯带练岗会被机器人辅助替代，懂评估、会沟通、能调方案的助理更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选康复治疗、运动康复或护理专业，医院实习是必须的。解剖基础要扎实，跟患者打交道的耐心要练。
把康复机器人、外骨骼和 AI 评估系统学起来，考取康复治疗师资格。从「带练」升级为「评估+指导+方案调整」复合角色。
康复或护理背景最顺，无背景可从康复助理或理疗技师切入再考证。简历上多写「带过哪些类型患者、会什么设备、有没有考过证」。
招助理别只看证书，要看耐心和观察力。愿意学智能康复设备的年轻人，值得重点培养。

ai_s7_trends: 康复机器人与外骨骼进入康复科，助理从「纯带练」转向「设备操作+训练指导」，会智能设备的助理更抢手。
老龄化与康复医疗扩张推动岗位需求增长，康复治疗师资格成为职业跃升关键。
远程康复与可穿戴监测普及，助理向「院内带练+居家跟进」复合角色转变。

body: 物理治疗师助理在物理治疗师指导下执行康复训练与物理治疗操作，负责指导患者完成指定训练、操作理疗设备、记录训练反应与进展，是康复治疗团队中的一线执行角色。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can compare prices across the internet in one minute and generate purchase orders automatically, but purchasing managers still decide whether to renew a supplier and how to negotiate the current contract.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 83,500 purchasing managers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 86,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,600 jobs, with approximately 6,400 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $139,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace purchasing managers, but it will replace much execution work. Inquiries, price comparisons, order processing, and supplier data management can move to AI and procurement platforms, shifting managers from running processes toward setting strategy, negotiating major deals, and managing risk. The truly scarce capability is making judgments beyond data and delivering results at the negotiating table.
ai_s2_accel: AI price forecasting and cost analysis
AI review and comparison of contract terms
ai_s2_auto: Automation of inquiries, price comparisons, and quotation analysis
Online purchase-order generation and approval workflows
Supplier qualification review and data management
ai_s3_list: Negotiation strategy: delivery dates, payment, and warranties are negotiated alongside price.
Supplier relationships: key suppliers depend on long-term trust, which AI cannot provide.
Risk judgment: signs of supply disruption, price increases, and supplier failure often require industry instinct.
Category expertise: understanding technology and markets is necessary to negotiate effectively with suppliers.
Decision accountability: purchasing decisions require signatures; AI provides data but cannot bear responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means AI is replacing much of the execution layer. Inquiries, price comparisons, orders, and data are precisely the traditional tasks purchasing specialists perform most often.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: The key to moderate-to-high risk is segmentation: order-tracking procurement roles face replacement, while purchasing managers with supplier resources, negotiation skills, and risk-management capabilities gain value. AI lowers procurement's entry barrier and makes senior judgment more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Supply-chain management and procurement remain worthwhile fields, but develop data analysis, negotiation, and risk awareness. Procurement in the AI era is not placing orders; it is using data, negotiating, and managing supply chains.

Give inquiries and price comparisons to AI and devote time to supplier strategy and annual negotiations. Earn CPSM or similar supply-chain certifications and progress toward category manager and supply-chain director, remaining secure even as execution layers contract.

People from manufacturing, trade, or sales can enter procurement by starting as specialists and building supplier resources. Candidates who use procurement platforms and AI tools while understanding industry markets advance more easily than those who only follow processes.

Do not hire purchasing managers only by years of experience; examine categories managed and savings delivered. Equip teams with AI procurement tools and free specialists from order tracking to work on strategy. This is how supply-chain teams evolve.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Supply interruption, price increase, and public sentiment monitoring

ai_s7_trends: E-procurement and AI price comparisons become standard, while order-tracking procurement roles continue to contract.
Stronger supply-chain risk awareness shifts purchasing managers toward strategy and risk management.
Growing green procurement and compliance requirements make category expertise a core competitive advantage.

body: Purchasing Managers develop and execute organizational procurement strategies, manage supplier resources, organize inquiries, price comparisons, and negotiations, control purchasing costs, and ensure timely, stable material supply.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can compare prices across the internet in one minute and generate purchase orders automatically, but purchasing managers still decide whether to renew a supplier and how to negotiate the current contract.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟比完全网报价、自动生成采购订单，但「跟这家供应商续不续约、这轮合同怎么谈」，还得采购经理拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采购经理在岗约 8.35 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.61 万人，净增约 0.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.64 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.95 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采购经理，但会取代大量执行层工作。询价、比价、订单处理、供应商数据管理都能交给 AI 和采购平台，经理的时间从「跑流程」挪向「定策略、谈大单、管风险」。真正稀缺的，是在数据之外做判断、在谈判桌上拿结果的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 价格预测与成本分析
供应商绩效的自动评估
合同条款的 AI 审查与比对
ai_s2_auto: 询价、比价与报价分析的自动化
采购订单生成与审批流程线上化
供应商资质审核与数据管理
到货与库存跟踪的系统化
ai_s3_list: 谈判策略：价格之外的交期、付款、质保，都在谈判桌上。
供应商关系：关键供应商要靠长期信任，AI 给不了人情往来。
风险判断：断供、涨价、暴雷的征兆，往往靠行业嗅觉。
品类专业度：懂技术、懂行情，才压得住供应商。
决策担责：采购决策要签字，AI 只能给数据不能背责任。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的执行层正在被 AI 大幅替代——询价、比价、订单、数据，这些恰恰是传统采购专员最常做的事。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中-高风险的关键在于分层：被替代的是「跟单型」采购，而掌握供应商资源、会谈判、能管理风险的采购经理价值反而上升。AI 让采购的门槛变低，也让高层的判断变得更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 供应链管理和采购专业依然值得，但要把数据分析、谈判和风险意识都练起来。AI 时代的采购不是「会下单」，是「会用数据、会谈判、会管供应链」。
把询价比价交给 AI，把时间投向供应商策略和年度谈判。考取 CPSM 等供应链认证，往品类经理和供应链总监方向走，执行层被压缩得再快也不影响你。
有制造、贸易或销售背景都可以切入采购，先做专员积累供应商资源。会用采购平台和 AI 工具、又懂行业行情的候选人，比只会走流程的更容易升上去。
招采购经理别只看年限，要看管理过什么品类、省下过多少钱。给团队配 AI 采购工具，把专员从跟单中解放出来做策略，是供应链团队的进化方向。

ai_s7_trends: 电子采购与 AI 比价成为标配，跟单型采购岗位持续收缩。
供应链风险意识强化，采购经理向战略与风险管理转型。
绿色采购与合规要求上升，品类专业度成为核心竞争力。

body: 采购经理（Purchasing Managers）负责制定和执行企业的采购策略，管理供应商资源，组织询价、比价与谈判，控制采购成本并保障物资供应的及时与稳定。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一分钟比完全网报价、自动生成采购订单，但「跟这家供应商续不续约、这轮合同怎么谈」，还得采购经理拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can adjust formulas automatically from color-difference data, but the person monitoring the dye bath still determines whether the fabric's color is right and whether uneven dyeing will appear in the next minute.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 6,200 textile machine operators and tenders were employed in 2024, projected to decrease to 5,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 700 jobs, with about 700 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $37,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not immediately replace dyeing and finishing operators, but it is changing the role. Automated weighing, formula databases, and online color measurement are already entering factories, making solution preparation and records machine-driven. Loading and unloading fabric, inspecting equipment, and handling fabric jams and uneven dyeing still require physical work and on-site judgment in the near term.
ai_s2_accel: Online color measurement and automatic color-difference assessment
AI-assisted color matching and formula optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated weighing and delivery of dyes and chemicals
Digital production scheduling and shift handoffs
ai_s3_list: Color judgment: Lighting and fabric type change how colors appear.
Process understanding: Temperature, liquor ratio, and additives must work together.
Equipment feel: People handle fabric jams, roller entanglement, and dye-vat faults.
Exception response: People correct uneven color and color differences.
Responsibility: Every parameter affects the quality of an entire fabric batch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates a workshop occupation with moderate AI exposure. Solution preparation, recordkeeping, and formulas offer substantial room for digitization, but AI cannot yet handle the physical and experience-based work of loading vats, judging color, and resolving equipment anomalies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not justify complacency. Dye-vat automation makes operators who only start machines redundant. Study color matching, processes, and equipment maintenance to advance from a button pusher into someone who understands the process.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When studying textile dyeing and finishing, do not aim only for operator roles. Build a strong foundation in dyeing processes and dye chemistry and spend substantial internship time in workshops. Advancing into process-technician roles offers better prospects than remaining a machine tender for life.

Do not remain in repetitive operations. Learn color matching and process-parameter optimization and volunteer to manage automated equipment. Record experienced workers' color judgment and develop your own. This makes you indispensable to the workshop.

People without formal education can enter as apprentices or helpers, aiming to master independent vat monitoring and color matching quickly. In interviews, emphasize endurance, steady hands, and color sensitivity. Career changers can learn equipment maintenance.

Retaining workshop workers is difficult. Combine transparent piece rates, color-matching and process training, and advancement pathways. Develop experienced workers into process technicians and use automation to reduce physical strain rather than headcount.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Precise measurement of dyes and chemicals

ai_s7_trends: Dye-vat automation and digital monitoring are spreading, reducing purely physical roles.
Green dyeing and finishing and energy-efficient processes are becoming the industry's central direction, increasing demand for people who understand processes.
Low-end capacity is moving abroad, while demand for high-end functional-fabric dyeing and finishing is rising.

body: Textile bleaching and dyeing machine operators and tenders operate bleaching, dyeing, printing, and finishing equipment, prepare dyes and chemicals, monitor process parameters, resolve anomalies, and complete fabric pretreatment, coloring, and finishing.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can adjust formulas automatically from color-difference data, but the person monitoring the dye bath still determines whether the fabric's color is right and whether uneven dyeing will appear in the next minute.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能根据色差数据自动调配方，但「这缸布现在的颜色对不对、下一分钟会不会色花」，还得靠盯缸的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年纺织机器操作员看护员在岗约 0.62 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.55 万人，岗位净减约 0.07 万个，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会立刻取代染整操作员，但正在改写岗位：自动称料、配方数据库、在线测色已经进厂，把配液和记录变成机器的事；而装缸卸布、巡检设备、处理堵布和色花，这些车间里的身体劳动和现场判断，短时间内还得靠人。
ai_s2_accel: 在线测色与色差自动判定
AI 辅助调色与配方优化
无人化物流与布匹转运
ai_s2_auto: 工艺参数自动记录与报表
生产排程与交接数字化
ai_s3_list: 看色功底：光线和布种不同，颜色判断不同。
工艺理解：温度、浴比、助剂怎么配合。
设备手感：堵布、缠辊、染缸故障的处理。
异常应变：色花、色差出现时的补救。
责任心：每个参数都影响整批布质量。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明染整操作是「中等 AI 曝光」的车间岗位：配液、记录、配方这些环节数字化空间大，但装缸、看色、处理设备异常这些体力加经验的活，AI 还够不着。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧：染缸自动化让「只会开机」的操作员变多余。往调色、工艺、设备维护方向学，把自己从「按按钮的人」升级成「懂工艺的人」，才是安全区。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学纺织染整专业别只奔着操作岗，把染整工艺、染料化学学扎实，实习时多下车间，将来往工艺员或技术员走，比当一辈子挡车工有前途。
别停在重复操作上：学调色、学工艺参数优化，主动接手自动化设备；把老师傅的看色经验记下来，形成自己的判断，你会成为车间离不开的人。
没学历可以从学徒或辅助工入行，目标是快速掌握独立看缸和调色；面试时强调能吃苦、手稳、对颜色敏感。想转型的可以往设备维护方向学一门技术。
车间留人难，建议「计件透明 + 调色/工艺培训 + 晋升通道」一起给，把熟练工培养成工艺员，用自动化减轻他们的体力劳动，而不是减人。

body: 纺织漂染机器操作员与看护员操作漂白、染色、印花等染整设备，配置染化料、监控工艺参数、处理异常，完成织物的前处理、上色与后整理。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate grinding parameters and manage tool life, but a grinder still has to use sight and measuring instruments to verify the correct relief angle on a drill bit and whether the grinding wheel is properly dressed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 5,800 tool grinders, filers, and sharpeners were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 5,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 400 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 500 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $49,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate tool grinders, but it will replace standardized sharpening. CNC grinders, automatic sharpening machines, and tool-life management systems are spreading, making the grinding of ordinary standard tools increasingly automated. The remaining value lies in irregular-tool work, high-precision grinding, and process judgment, experience-based crafts AI cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: Online inspection equipment provides real-time grinding-quality feedback
Robotic loading and unloading automates grinding
Automated tool coating and surface treatment
ai_s2_auto: Digital tool inspection and life-cycle management
Digital tool inventory and issue systems
ai_s3_list: Grinding feel: intuitive judgment of contact between wheel and tool.
Irregular-tool handling: improvise solutions beyond standard programs.
Precision inspection: use sight and measuring instruments to verify edge quality.
Process experience: select grinding parameters for different tool materials.
Dressing judgment: assess wheel condition and the right time to dress it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates that automation concentrates on grinding standard tools. CNC grinders and automatic sharpeners replace repetitive sharpening, but irregular tools, high-precision grinding, and process judgment depend on grinder experience, making those capabilities scarcer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk does not mean there is no future. Automatic sharpeners will replace workers who only grind standard tools, while companies actively seek grinders who can program CNC machines, understand grinding processes, and handle irregular tools. Learn CNC and inspection skills, and AI becomes an assistant.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vocational programs in CNC machining and mechanics provide entry and suit steady, patient students. Do not learn only manual sharpening; CNC grinder programming and inspection will be the future livelihood. An internship in a company's toolroom is especially valuable.

Learn CNC grinder programming and online inspection, then advance toward tool technician or grinding process technician roles. Volunteer for irregular-tool and high-precision work, scarce crafts that automatic sharpeners cannot replace.

People with CNC, fitting, or machining experience transition most easily. When job hunting, present the tool types and precision cases you have handled. Employers value versatile grinders who can program independently and inspect results.

Assign routine sharpening to automatic equipment and focus recruitment on people who program CNC machines and grind irregular tools. Provide grinders with strong inspection equipment and training, and capture experienced workers' parameters in a database so expertise does not leave with the individual.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你算磨削参数、管理刀具寿命，但一支钻头的后角该磨多少、砂轮修整得对不对，还得磨工靠眼睛和量具来把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工具磨削、锉削与刃磨工在岗约 0.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.54 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让工具磨削工消失，但会替代「标准化刃磨」：CNC 磨床、自动刃磨机、刀具寿命管理系统在普及，普通标准刀具的磨削越来越自动化。留下来的价值在于异形刀具处理、高精度磨削和磨削工艺判断——这些靠经验和手艺的活，AI 替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 在线检测设备实时反馈磨削质量
机器人上下料实现磨削自动化
数字孪生辅助磨削工艺仿真
刀具涂层与表面处理自动化
ai_s2_auto: 刀具检测与寿命管理数字化
磨削参数的数据库化推荐
刀具库存与领用系统电子化
ai_s3_list: 磨削手感：砂轮与刀具接触的直觉判断。
异形刀具处理：标准程序之外的临场方案。
精度检验：用眼睛和量具把关刃口质量。
工艺经验：不同材质刀具的磨削参数。
修整判断：砂轮状态与修整时机。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「标准刀具的磨削动作」：CNC 磨床和自动刃磨机能替代重复刃磨，但异形刀具、高精度磨削和磨削工艺判断依赖磨工的经验，这部分价值反而更稀缺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没出路：只会磨标准刀具的会被自动刃磨机替代，会数控编程、懂磨削工艺、能处理异形刀具的磨工则是企业抢着要的；把数控和检测技能学起来，AI 反而是你的帮手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数控、机械技校专业是入口，适合手稳、坐得住的孩子。提醒：别只学手工刃磨，数控磨床编程和检测才是以后的饭碗，进企业工具间实习比什么都强。
把 CNC 磨床编程和在线检测学起来，往工具技师、磨削工艺员方向走。主动接手异形刀具和高精度磨削的活，这些是自动刃磨机替代不了的稀缺手艺。
有数控、钳工、机加工经验的人转行最顺。求职时带上你磨过的刀具类型和精度案例，企业更认「能独立编程 + 会检验」的复合磨工。
普通刃磨交给自动设备，重点招聘会数控编程和异形刀具磨削的人。给磨工配好检测设备和培训，把老师傅的磨削参数沉淀成数据库，别让手艺跟着人走。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Platforms can automatically create and distribute courses, but managers still decide which capabilities to develop first, how to align them with business needs, and how to measure results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 46,400 training and development managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 49,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,800 jobs, with approximately 3,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $127,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace training managers, but it will reduce routine delivery work. Learning platforms and AI-generated content accelerate standard courses, shifting managers from scheduling classes to capability gap diagnosis, system design, vendor governance, impact measurement, and organizational development. Those who only schedule classes will be squeezed out, while managers with diagnostic skills and strategic judgment will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Capability diagnosis: people must uncover the pain points.
System design: people must build the structure.
Business alignment: people must articulate the value.
Vendor governance: people must make the tradeoffs.
Organizational development: people must set the direction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure to automation: systems are accelerating standard courses, but capability diagnosis and organizational design still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. The tasks being replaced involve scheduling and delivering courses, not designing organizational capabilities. Managers with diagnostic skills and strategic judgment will become even scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who can only manage course schedules face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you are starting in HR, psychology, or education, build business acumen early. Pure course scheduling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop diagnostic skills as soon as possible.
Advance from managing courses to diagnosing needs and building systems. Learn to use data and seek opportunities to align learning with the business.
Highlight examples of learning systems and ROI, and clearly state which business functions you have supported. Employers value practical execution.
Do not hire based only on an outgoing personality. Look for business judgment. People who can build a learning system are worth paying a premium.

ai_s7_trends: As learning platforms become widespread, standard courses are shrinking.
Organizational development and strategic talent development offer opportunities.
Managers with strong diagnostic skills are in greater demand.

body: Training and development managers diagnose organizational capability gaps, design learning and development systems, oversee training budgets, courses, and vendors, and measure how development affects business results.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 平台能自动出课推课，但哪类能力先补、怎么和业务对齐、效果怎么算，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年培训与发展经理在岗约 4.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.92 万人，净增约 0.28 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.38 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代培训经理，但会压缩标准交付。学习平台与 AI 内容生成把常规课程提速，经理从「排课」挪向「能力诊断、体系设计、供应商治理、效果衡量、组织发展」。真正被挤掉的是只管排课的人，有诊断力和战略脑的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 能力诊断：痛点靠人挖。
体系设计：结构靠人搭。
业务对齐：价值靠人谈。
供应商治理：取舍靠人。
组织发展：方向靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的培训区——标准课程被系统加速，但诊断与组织设计还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排课交付」动作，不是「能力设计」的岗位。有诊断力和战略脑的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会排课表的培训管理者。

ai_s5_persona.建议: HR/心理/教育起步多练业务理解，AI 时代纯排课在缩，早点练诊断。
从「管课」升级成「做诊断 + 搭体系」，学数据，争取和业务对齐。
突出体系和 ROI 案例，写清服务过哪些业务。企业看重落地。
选人别只看活泼，要看有没有业务脑。能搭体系的人，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 学习平台普及，标准课缩。
组织发展与战略培养有机会。
有诊断力的经理更抢手。

body: 培训与发展经理诊断组织能力缺口，设计学习与发展体系，统筹培训预算、课程与供应商，并衡量培养对业务结果的影响。
